blurb: Abbotsford Dance Center offers a variety of dance programs for all ages including early childhood dance, recreational and competitive dance, and adult classes. They also provide a private studio rental space and host high-energy dance and acro party experiences. The center emphasizes skill building, fun, and performance opportunities such as year-end recitals.
